# `Browser.Motion.Internals`

[Back to stdlib index](../stdlib.md)

Ipe.Browser.Motion.Internals — the low-level Motion port surface: the
closed outbound/inbound ADTs and the raw `Ipe.Ffi.Js` request/subscribe
wiring the high-level `Ipe.Browser.Motion` layer wraps.

Importing this submodule discloses the same `js-port:motion` axis as the
top-level module (the disclosure is keyed on the `Ipe.Browser.Motion` path
prefix), so the raw port surface cannot be reached undisclosed.

## `JsCmd`

The ONE closed OUTBOUND port type.

  * `Watch` — begin a session-stream: `devicemotion` events arrive on the
    inbound subscription.
  * `StopWatch` — remove the active listener. A no-op when no watch is active.

## `JsMsg`

The NARROW closed INBOUND port type — deliberately NOT the app's internal
`Msg`. Every variant the browser can push is enumerated, so the fold in the
high-level layer is EXHAUSTIVE and an unavailability can never be silently
dropped.

  * `Reading accelX accelY accelZ rotAlpha rotBeta rotGamma` — a
    `devicemotion` event. Acceleration fields are in m/s²; rotation-rate
    fields are in degrees/second. All are `Maybe Float` because the browser
    may deliver `null` for axes the device does not support.
  * `Unavailable` — the `devicemotion` event is absent in this context.

## `request`

```ipe
request : JsCmd -> Cmd.Cmd msg
```

`request cmd` — hand a closed outbound `JsCmd` to the raw port transport.

## `subscribe`

```ipe
subscribe : (JsMsg -> msg) -> Sub.Sub msg
```

`subscribe toMsg` — the inbound subscription over the fail-closed seal
decoder. `inbound` IS the security gate; a malformed / mismatched frame is
dropped whole. A decoded `JsMsg` is handed to `toMsg`.

## `inbound`

```ipe
inbound : Decode.Decoder JsMsg
```

The total, fail-closed decoder for a `JsMsg` frame of this capability.

It first requires the frame's `tag` to be `portTag`, so a frame of another
capability, or an untagged one, fails closed; the rest decodes as `inboundBody`.
